purpose: Workshop-oriented runtime and typed-interface evaluation added after the original results; not a public preregistration
registry_operation: Build exact primary graph, sharp absolute and 40-step relative certificates, and solve uniform expected-cost planner from already-built local contribution tables
registry_timing_excludes: Network, parsing, SQL baseline queries, initial model construction, independent LP verification, figure generation, and file writing
synthetic_operation: One all-pairs integer support call, comparing identical-table multiplicity grouping against an ungrouped loop over the same exact tables
local_operation: One all-pairs integer support call on an explicitly enumerated repeated-unprofiled patient block; table construction and enumeration measured separately
interpretation: Measured serial kernel scaling on a frozen registry and declared synthetic workloads, not a new biological cohort, all-cBioPortal evaluation, HPC benchmark, or distributed-system result
constraints: KIRC-VHL single-query sensitivity to hypothetical upper caps on unknown broad positives and guaranteed point-width reduction from measuring previously unknown patients; no cap is inferred from data
